descriptionHtml: I'm Ben, a student in IT and an aspiring Junior DevOps engineer based in Belgium. I believe in Automation. I build and run infrastructure with Proxmox, Ansible, OpenTofu and Linux. I care about clean, reproducible setups and I enjoy turning ideas into working products. My goal is simple: create Efficient, High-impact solutions that are easy to maintain.
